title: Deerskin / P-KAS origins: geometry, calcium and the audit trail
summary: An older-roots pass through the speculative Deerskin and P-KAS branches that fed the Geometric Neuron ecosystem. It keeps the useful mechanisms and empirical receipts, but also records the later audit: the ECG loop does not have to oscillate, MoireNet's XOR advantage was a restart-budget artifact, phase-addressed memory failed its no-probe null, and the strongest surviving empirical claim is the zero-parameter EEG result in Geometric-Neuron.

nodes.claim: The speculative Deerskin origin: neuronal membranes as geometric sampling/interference surfaces, with moire mismatch, homeostatic feedback and phase/timing used as computational primitives.
nodes.survived: The ECG-like feedback phenomenon and its sampling-resolution dependence were reproduced and mechanized; the tap-position intervention survived; Fourier/Janus multiplexing retained a real two-channel I/Q capacity result; and the sibling Geometric-Neuron EEG result remains untouched at p = 0.007, d = -1.21 with zero trained parameters.
nodes.killed: The claim that finite-resolution feedback must oscillate is false because dead/fixed regimes exist; the MoireNet XOR advantage disappears under matched restart budget; the four-spin memory claim collapses to two I/Q channels; and phase-addressed retrieval in the sibling test fails wrong-phase/no-probe nulls.

nodes.claim: A Phase-Calcium-Latent constraint solver: Kuramoto-like phases provide fast state, a calcium-like accumulator gates local adaptation, and an optional global ephaptic field supplies collective feedback.
nodes.survived: In the repository's 3-SAT benchmark, the local PCL arm reports higher clause satisfaction than the field-augmented PCLF arm (94.7% versus 89.1%), supporting the narrower toy result that local temporal integration/gating can outperform the tested global synchronizing field.
nodes.killed: The repository itself later states that it is not a biophysical calcium model. The result does not establish biological calcium credit assignment, superiority to modern SAT solvers, or that a global field is generally harmful.

nodes.claim: Explicitly fuses P-KAS phase/calcium/W-matrix dynamics with the Deerskin geometric prior, replacing an external temperature schedule with stress-driven viscous adaptation.
nodes.survived: The geometric-prior version removes the catastrophic phase-collapse behavior of the original P-KAS control and reaches about 78% on the stated 50-node 3-regular MaxCut benchmark versus about 58% for the original P-KAS arm.
nodes.killed: It does not beat the classical simulated-annealing baseline (about 86%), and the gauge-theory language is explicitly presented as a productive metaphor rather than a formal derivation.

nodes.claim: A synthesis of the Deerskin hypothesis with measured dwell-time hierarchies, proposing that sampling geometry generates slow-to-fast cortical dwell gradients and that alpha-like near-Nyquist layers are especially fragile.
nodes.survived: The toy demonstrates that changing geometric sampling density can create different dwell statistics without standard learned scalar weights, making it a useful mechanistic sandbox for the measured dwell hierarchy.
nodes.killed: Its strong statement that the feedback system must oscillate is contradicted by the later Deerskin/V21 regime-map audit, which found abundant fixed/dead states. Matching the direction of AD-like summary metrics is not by itself validation of the proposed biological mechanism.

nodes.claim: A broad Takens/Deerskin laboratory combining parameter-free delay-geometry recognition, theta timing gates, homeostatic delay growth and later outer-loop/visual experiments.
nodes.survived: The repository records the two mechanisms that later remain load-bearing in Geometric-Neuron: 87.4% zero-parameter frequency discrimination and frustration-driven growth from a short delay bank to the depth needed for about 92% context-gap accuracy.
nodes.killed: The broad claim that this is a biological replacement for Transformer attention was not established, and later Geometric-Neuron audits narrow phase from a general memory mechanism to timing/direction-specific roles.

edges.why: PkasDeerskin's lineage explicitly names the Deerskin Hypothesis as one of the ingredients fused with P-KAS and Fractal Instinct.
Deerskin-Cortex explicitly describes itself as a synthesis between Phi-Dwell and the Deerskin Hypothesis.
Both repositories instantiate the P-KAS phase/calcium local-credit idea, but PkasDeerskin cites the broader P-KAS conversation history rather than this solver as direct code ancestry.
Takens-Gated-Deerskin explicitly points to Geometric-Neuron as the new de-cluttered repository concentrating the schizophrenia-recognition result from the broader idea set.
The audited Deerskin README explicitly identifies V21 as the full autopsy of its original ECG loop and uses that downstream analysis to retire the must-oscillate deduction.

motifs.title: Local temporal traces repeatedly beat or replace global control
motifs.description: P-KAS/PCL uses a calcium-like local accumulator as temporal integration and plasticity gate; PkasDeerskin retains that trace while adding a slower geometric prior. The useful recurring object is the local history/credit trace, not the claim that the toy literally models calcium.

motifs.title: Descendants are allowed to kill the parent
motifs.description: The Deerskin origin is unusually useful as genealogy because later tools are explicitly turned back on it: V21 kills must-oscillate, matched budgets kill the XOR advantage, and phase-memory nulls kill the retrieval story while the EEG and sampling/tap results remain.
